claims.claim: Added exact content-bound roa-1-r2 version 2 for REPAIR_AUTHORING with five ordered checks, one procedure and one final closure.

ROA subjects bind packet, profile, return contract, repair, failure, TASK and source identities. Outcomes distinguish OBSERVED, INFERRED and UNKNOWN; missing decisive sources require UNKNOWN blockers without candidate exposure.
ROA requires explicit isolated conformance mode. Ordinary attempts reject ROA, mixed stages and dual audit carriers; existing prospective V1 selection remains unchanged.
Historical profile content and two-stage envelopes remain intact. The registry permits four recognized identities within its unchanged byte bound, with exact ROA digest enforcement.

ROA validation rejects malformed closures, substituted profiles, forged references and stale bindings. Provider attempts enforce freshness before returning the single-call result and perform no lifecycle mutation.
Added focused valid and adversarial regression cases covering ROA, both provider transports, unauthorized activation, no fallback and historical compatibility.

Committed changes affect only the eight permitted paths. AUTHOR_REPAIR ingress, authority boundaries, roadmap NEXT and frozen Kernel remain unmodified; documentation identifies isolated support without production cutover or measured performance claims.
